input: Plan a themed movie marathon night with roommates

gold.taskTitle: Plan a themed movie marathon night with roommates
gold.taskDescription: Organise a fun, themed movie marathon night at home with roommates, covering theme selection, movie picks, scheduling, snacks, and setup.

questions.title: What theme are you considering for the marathon?
questions.description: Understand the genre or concept the user has in mind, such as horror, 80s classics, a specific director, or a franchise.

questions.title: How many roommates are joining the marathon?
questions.description: Know the group size to plan seating, snack quantities, and voting on movies.

questions.title: Which date and start time are you targeting?
questions.description: Pin down the schedule so all planning can be aligned to a specific evening.

questions.title: How many movies do you want to watch in one night?
questions.description: Determine the length and pace of the marathon to build a realistic watchlist.

questions.title: What streaming services or physical media do you have access to?
questions.description: Identify available platforms so movie selection stays within what the group can actually watch.

questions.title: What kind of food and drinks are you planning to serve?
questions.description: Clarify whether snacks will be homemade, ordered in, or store-bought, and any dietary restrictions to consider.

questions.title: Do you want any decorations or themed setup for the room?
questions.description: Understand how far the user wants to go with ambiance, such as themed props, lighting, or dress codes.
